sentiment.rationale: Full-year revenue guidance was raised by 75 basis points to 3.75%-4.75% growth, and adjusted EPS guidance was raised to $2.52-$2.62 from $2.50-$2.60, while adjusted operating income guidance was held unchanged. The guidance raise is organic, driven by strong sales momentum and share gains, not attributed to FX or one-time items. However, the unchanged operating income guidance and cautious language about tariff uncertainty and cost pressures prevent a higher score.

summary.revenue: Total revenues of $177.4 billion, up 4.8% reported, up 5.6% in constant currency.
summary.guidance: Full-year net sales growth guidance raised to 3.75% to 4.75% (cc); adjusted EPS guidance raised to $2.52 to $2.62; adjusted operating income guidance unchanged at 3.5% to 5.5% (cc). Q3 net sales growth guidance 3.75% to 4.75% (cc); Q3 operating income growth guidance 3.0% to 6.0% (cc).
summary.margin: Consolidated gross margin rate increased 4 bps to 24.5%; adjusted operating expenses deleveraged 35 bps to 21.0% of net sales.
key_risks: Higher self-insured general liability claims expense in the U.S. ($450 million incremental in Q2, 560 bps headwind to adjusted operating income growth).
Tariff-related cost pressures expected to continue into Q3 and Q4, with costs increasing each week.
Uncertainty around final tariff resolution across largest import markets.
Merchandise category mix headwind as grocery and health & wellness sales outpace general merchandise.
Currency exchange rate fluctuations (negative impact of $1.5 billion on revenue in Q2).
key_opportunities: Global eCommerce sales grew 25%, with all segments exceeding 20% growth.
Global advertising business grew 46% (including VIZIO); Walmart Connect U.S. up 31%.
AI and technology investments, including new AI acceleration role and super-agents (Sparky).
Share gains across income brackets, led by upper-income households.
New OnePay cash rewards credit card launching before holiday.
International growth led by China, Walmex, and Flipkart.

management_tone.label: confident
management_tone.justification: Management expresses confidence in the business model and strategy, stating 'we're positioned to win' and 'we feel good about the back half of the year,' while acknowledging uncertainty.
